lines.1: Today was day two of the Matsukasa Port Opening Festival.
lines.2: Put simply, it was a citywide festival.
lines.3: It was one of summer vacation's biggest events.
lines.4: The highlight of day two was, without a doubt, the fireworks display.
lines.5: The beach was packed with spectators.
lines.7: With a boom that rumbled in my gut, a huge flower bloomed in the night sky.
lines.8: 「I'm glad we got such a good spot.」
lines.9: 「We won by getting an early start.」
lines.12: 「You're quick when it really matters, but most of the time you're pretty sluggish...」
lines.13: One after another, the fireworks lit up the dark sky.
lines.18: I can hear you, Ms. Konoe.
lines.19: But that was all we said.
lines.20: For a while, we just watched the sky together.
lines.21: What was it about a fleeting flash of light that captivated everyone who saw it?
lines.22: I couldn't tell what Konoe was thinking, but she gazed intently at the flowers in the sky.
lines.23: After a while, the rush of fireworks eased up.
lines.24: 「...Phew. The fireworks are beautiful, your bento's delicious... I couldn't ask for more.」
lines.25: 「You put a lot of effort into this bento, didn't you?」
lines.27: 「The fresh nicks on your fingers say otherwise.」
lines.29: 「Oh, and if you want, try it with some peanut butter.」
lines.30: Konoe slid the container toward me.
lines.31: 「You can't just put this stuff on everything.」
lines.34: 「Oh, by the way, was it really okay to leave your whole childhood-friend gang behind? They sounded awfully noisy over the phone.」
lines.36: 「Up through last year, I watched the fireworks with that bunch.」
lines.38: 「Well, I chose seeing you in a yukata over going with them.」
lines.41: 「I had trouble saying it to your face because I was embarrassed, but...」
lines.42: 「You look amazing. So beautiful I can barely look you in the eye.」
lines.43: Another burst of fireworks lit up the sky.
lines.45: 「E-even if it's embarrassing, proper etiquette says you have to say things like that clearly!」
lines.47: 「Wow, you're using the fireworks to drown yourself out.」
lines.48: 「Give yourself over to the mood a little more.」
lines.49: 「I'd get carried away in front of everyone.」
lines.50: 「Well, yeah, completely forgetting public decency would be a problem.」
lines.51: 「But keeping your cool all the time is kind of...」
lines.54: 「...Hey, Tsushima. Give me your ear for a second.」
lines.60: 「(Is it!? What are the people behind us going to think--)」
lines.65: All at once, affection for Konoe welled up inside me.
lines.70: 「Ahaha, now you're getting into it. My temptation worked.」
lines.72: 「It's a festival. We can get away with this much.」
lines.75: Yeah, it's a festival... We can get away with this much.
lines.76: But the people behind us looked extremely annoyed! (Naturally.)
lines.77: 「Ugh, the looks we're getting really are awkward.」
lines.78: 「Y-yeah... That's actually a pretty good point.」
lines.80: 「Oh? But is that really okay with you, Tsushima?」
lines.81: Even if she asked whether I was really okay with it...
